ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Deal flow, Screening and later stages need Deal lead and Round type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Deal_flow", CASE(StageName, "Sourced", 1, "Screening", 2, "First meeting", 3, "Deep dive", 4, "Partner meeting", 5, "Term sheet", 6, "Due diligence", 7, "Investment committee", 8, "Invested", 9, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Deal_lead__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Round_type__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Deal lead and Round type before moving to Screening.
